title: 第12章 决定（求推荐收藏月票）
content_zh:
塔顶之上。
刘隆落地离去，独留下李皓。
“诱饵……”
李皓轻声呢喃，他彻底懂了刘隆的意思。
这家伙，看起来莽撞，实际上也是个心思细密的高手，一番话语下来，显得坦荡无比，开诚布公。
非但如此，还有一点，刘隆没明说，实际上却是在字里行间说的明白。
他刘隆，不会过河拆桥，也是个重情义的人！
这一点，从刘隆几次说，他不愿意去查，查执法队的内鬼，就这么一句话，其实就是刘隆在表态。
那些背叛我的，我都不忍心去伤害他们。
你李皓，如果愿意帮我，那我更不会忘恩负义。
这才是高手！
润物无声，没说在明面上，然而你稍微深思一下，就能听懂，连叛徒，刘隆都因为感情不愿去对付，何况他人。
“真这么重感情吗？”
李皓心中想着，没敢全部相信，也不敢全部当真。
这群人，都太奸诈了。
刚刚刘隆一番话，用了太多计策，虚张声势、声东击西、威逼恫吓、晓之以理……短短几句话的交谈，也不知道刘隆耗费了多少脑细胞。
“杀超能者，剥夺神秘能，匹配自身，一次引入不行，二次引入，三次引入……这样就可以成为新的超能者？”
李皓忽然有些心寒。
超能者的世界，好像也没那么太平。
连刘隆这样的普通人都想着搏杀超能者蜕变，那超能者彼此之间呢？

也许更凶险！
难怪这些超能者低调无比，不显于人前，恐怕也是为了避免一些无端的麻烦。
“刘隆看似告诉我许多，实际上全部都是点到为止，并未深入去说，大概我不加入执法队，他不会告诉我太多的东西。”
比如超能者具体的修炼方式，引能方式，实力强弱，能力类型……
这些东西，刘隆全部没有说。
“还有，我身上有神秘能，是真的有，还是假的？只是故意这么说罢了，让我失态，从而承认我的确在张家拿走了什么东西？”
李皓怀疑，很有这个可能。
刘隆其实不知道一点，李皓可以看到神秘能，这恐怕不是一般人具备的本事。
那星光般的能量，大概率就是神秘能。
而李皓可以看见的，他能看到自己体表外没有这样的能量，否则，之前红影也好，红影背后的人也好，不可能一点没反应。
刘隆大概率是在诈自己！
至于刘隆本人，李皓其实倒是真看到一点点东西，那家伙体表外，好像有一股微弱的星光能量，很微弱，可能就是神秘能。
“刘隆杀过超能者，还吸收过他们的神秘能，只是恐怕没到质变的时候，所以他体内是有神秘能残存的，那这么说的话，刘隆还真有可能成为超能者。”
是的，他能看到。
就如红影一样！
一般人看不到红影，李皓却是可以。
不止刘隆，刘隆身边那几位队员，或多或少，是真的具备一点神秘能在身上。
他口中的“我们”，李皓大体上也有些猜测，可能就是那几位队员，风情万种的女人，追踪探索的吴超，以及另外两位队员。
加上刘隆，总共5人，而不是执法队所有人。
看样子，执法队内部，其实还有一个小团队，也就是刘隆他们所组成的猎杀者联盟，专门猎杀超能者。

“大威力的武器吗？还是说，其他手段？”
超能者一定不弱，否则刘隆没必要那么追求，然而，却是有超能者死在他们手中，这个小团队其实也很可怕。
天时地利，都在巡检司这边。
动用大威力武器，也是巡检司的权力，哪怕事后有人追查，执法队也能轻易搪塞过去，如此一来，超能者稍有不慎，被这些人干掉，也不是不可能。
李皓拿着一把射程只有50米的旋涡三代，都敢打超能者的主意，何况刘隆这家伙。
严格来说，这位其实就是银城暴力机构的真正负责人。
至于巡检司司长，人家坐办公室的，可不会亲自来一线，执法队才是一线，刘隆才是这里的老大。
李皓走下了塔顶。
边走边思考。
自己若是拒绝，会有什么后果？
刘隆会不会找自己麻烦？
红影这边，刘隆会不会通风报信，甚至告诉他们，张家的刀，李家的剑，都在李皓身上？
又或者，干脆暗中弄死自己？
“看起来是个坦荡的大汉……实际上可是个心狠手辣的家伙！”
这时候，李皓一点不觉得对方莽撞了。
甚至执法队的不作为，都有可能是他故意放任的，让外人放松警惕，让超能者放松警惕，认为银城执法队只是个样子货。
示敌以弱！
“内鬼……呵呵，不会是刘隆自己故意培养的吧？哪怕不是，也是他放任的结果，这家伙百分百知道，谁才是内鬼，没有清理，只是故意这么做罢了！”
脑筋迅速转动的李皓，这一刻好像看清了许多东西。
执法队的刘隆，绝对是一号人物！

执法队的混乱不堪，大概率都是他自己故意造成的，这家伙太阴险了，难怪叫刘隆，果然坏的流脓！
心中腹诽一阵，李皓却也是开始思考，自己加入，是否有利？
“加入他们的话，对付红影就有帮手了，因为刘隆的目标就是这些超能者！”
“巡夜人我不熟，而且不知情况，甚至不知他们和红影是否有关联，刘隆这些人如果真的是为了成为超能者，那一定比巡夜人更尽心，只是实力偏弱。”
“不过有过击杀超能者的经历，代表他们也不是一点底气没有。”
此刻，李皓就是红影的下一个目标。
今天事情闹的这么大，红影一方，恐怕已经开始准备对自己下手了吧？
“其实就怕一点……”
李皓走上了街道，陷入了挣扎沉思中。
怕什么？
怕就怕……刘隆其实和红影是一方的，那才是真正的危险！
这一点，不是不可能的事。
“那样的话，我就真的危险了！”
李皓此刻不得不往这方面去想，如果刘隆是和红影一伙的，那这时候的自己，几乎什么都暴露出来了。
“呼！”
心情有些沉重。
今晚这步棋，走的不算太顺利，有些曲折，如果刘隆真的能对付红影还好，如果不能，那自己更危险了。
一声巨响，一辆大车，直接推平了张家老宅。
伴随着一阵烟雾，老宅外，李皓默默看着，仿佛看到了张远。
小远，你的家没了。

你死了，你的家也没了，你留在这个世界上最后的痕迹都快消散了。
而今，唯有给你报仇，用凶手的人头祭奠你，送你一程，我好像做不到其他了。
就在这时候，之前那风情万种的女队员，悄无声息地靠近了李皓。
鼻尖传来一阵淡淡的香味。
耳边，也传来了女人的笑声：“小皓，想加入我们，明天可以来找我！姐姐叫柳艳，执法队副队长，随时欢迎来找我！”
她不说名字，李皓还不知道她是谁，一说名字……李皓知道了。
在机要室一年，他哪怕没见过一些人，也听说过他们的名字，他们的八卦。
柳艳，也是机要室经常出现的名字之一。
听说是刘隆的姘头……当然，这是机要室传出来的八卦，是不是，李皓不知道，但是看今日的情况，也未必是空穴来风。
机要室几位大妈就经常用一副不屑的语气去说这位，说全靠脸蛋混到了执法队副队长的位置。
要知道，执法队副队长，最低也是一级巡检。
在巡检之上，还有巡察使。
刘隆其实就是巡察使，到了刘隆这一步，才算是真正拥有了话语权，在巡检司的地位，仅次于司长，几位副司长都没有刘隆实权大。
“好！”
李皓微微点头，痛快答应了。
识时务者为俊杰！
这时候，拒绝不得，也无法拒绝。
他必须要答应！
“爽快！”
柳艳顿时巧笑如烟，“你不会后悔的！”

话落，她已经离开。
速度很快，还是悄无声息，这也让李皓暗暗心惊，这几个家伙，看起来都是普通人，可实际上实力已经很强。
体表外，都有一层淡淡的星光笼罩。
很微弱，远距离未必可以看到，但是近距离，李皓却是可以看的清楚。
这正是玉剑泡水之后，自己喝水后消化不了，流淌出来的星光能量。
“半超能者吗？”
李皓心中下了定义，这几个家伙，恐怕都曾引能入体，只是没有成功，正式成为超能者。
刘隆在执法队倒是经营的不错，培养了几个强大的帮手出来。
“所以说，玉剑泡出来的水，就是神秘能！”
“刘隆他们指望杀超能者成为超能者，而我……也许未必！我的玉剑，可以为我提供神秘能，而且我还拿到了张家的刀，只是不知道张家的刀，能否泡出神秘能。”
轰隆声持续。
很快，火焰升腾。
张家，被焚烧了。
李皓默默看着，一点也不后悔今晚的选择。
今晚，他获得了很多信息，超乎想象的讯息，哪怕由此暴露了自己一些东西，那也没什么。
自己是李家的剑持有者，红影一方真的不知道吗？
未必吧！
一直没对自己动手，也许有他们自己的想法。
自己父母若是被他们杀的，他们岂会不知道，自己的李，就是李家的剑中的李！
认为他们不知道，那不过是自欺欺人罢了。

“动静这么大，对方大概不会现身的！”
李皓紧了紧衣衫，踢了踢身旁的黑豹，轻声道：“走了，回去了！”
没有和刘隆道别，趁着动静很大，李皓默默离去。
“老大！”
此刻，刘隆身边聚集了几人，柳艳看向刘隆，带着一些疑问之色，再看看黑暗中默默离去的李皓，轻声道：“老大真想让此人加入我们？”
瘦竹竿一般的吴超，幽幽笑道：“老大自然有老大的想法和道理！这个李皓，背后有人撑腰，袁硕虽然不是超能者，可袁硕一身五禽术，本身实力也不弱！何况，一直和巡夜人合作，还是有些底气的，拉李皓进入，未必是坏事。”
另一位胖的看不清眼睛的大胖子闷闷道：“那也不好说是好事！袁硕此人，心高气傲，之前老大不是没有找过对方，想要对方加入我们，一起猎杀，袁硕却是不屑一顾，拉李皓来，小心被巡夜人盯上……”
他还没说完，刘隆就冷冷道：“巡夜人？你以为巡夜人不知道？我银城巡检司，多次击杀超能者，他们怎么可能一点不知道？”
说罢，刘隆淡淡道：“知道又如何？我们杀的都是作奸犯科的超能者！而且，杀超能者，剥夺神秘能，让凡俗超脱，这个秘密就是巡夜人传出来的！呵呵……”
一声冷笑，刘隆眼中满是不屑和无所谓。
“他们传出这个消息，不就是为了让我们这些有心成为超能者的炮灰，为他们分担压力吗？”
“如今，巡夜人好像任务很重，没有时间管太多，可超能者一旦犯案，如果不管，那就是天大的麻烦！可管，巡夜人没有足够的力量去管，而凡俗对付超能者太危险，大多数都是得过且过，谁愿意真的得罪超能者？”
“然而，就在这时候，有消息传出，杀了超能者，引能入体，多次入体，总有几乎成功……你们说，这会导致什么结果？”
此话一出，众人沉默。
什么结果？
不甘于平凡的人，都会搏一次！
生死搏杀！
有手段，有武器，有脑子，未必不能逆伐超能者。
他们就是最好的证明！
而这样的事，就银城这边有吗？

恐怕不是！
巡夜人组织传出这样的消息，就是想借他们这些不甘平凡的人之手，当成炮灰，暂时为巡夜人解决一部分麻烦。
刘隆又道：“巡夜人的打算，精明的很！我们这些人，真要成了超能者，你说，我们会去哪？”
柳艳笑了：“巡夜人！”
众人点头。
巡检司的人，不去巡夜人，难道成为那些旁门左道？
大胖子吸气道：“好算计，这不是说，他们不耗费一点点神秘能，最终反而可能会吸收一部分脱颖而出的超凡者，而且还能解决一部分作乱的超能者！”
一箭双雕！
巡夜人只是透露一个消息罢了，最终的结果，就是成了超能者的巡检司成员，只能选择加入巡夜人，因为巡夜人是官方，是正统！
做惯了官，很少有人会去做贼。
“阳谋罢了！”
刘隆平静道：“其他人我不知道，但是每年失败的那批人，这些人都不会甘于平凡！我们也曾一脚踏入超凡，却是被踢回来了，没人会甘心！而我们这批人，都是各个巡检司的核心力量，我们有兵有权，有足够的底气，去争取一线机会！”
“巡夜人不需要付出任何代价，一方面可以让我们去搏，一方面还能挑选出一部分苗子，何乐而不为！”
这一刻，几位队员都是彻底明悟了。
之前刘隆没说的这么细致，几位队员中有人懂，有人如胖子，其实还是担心被巡夜人发现的，发现他们暗中剥夺神秘能。
可此刻，听队长这么一说，忽然豁然开朗！
大胖子又问道：“老大，那李皓加入……对我们有利吗？”
“有！”
刘隆说了一句，却是不解释为什么。
众人都是若有所思，没有细问。

至于李皓是否会加入……还用问？
肯定会！
几人觉得，只要知道超能领域，没人会拒绝刘隆的邀请。
巡夜人是有正规选拔，可不说选拔后，百里挑一的成功率，关键在于，李皓恐怕都没进入银城的候选人行列。
偌大的银城，知道超能者的不少。
都是高层！
多少高层希望自己，或者自己的后代可以成为超能者，李皓这种人，机会太小太小，哪怕他的老师出面，最后的结果，大概率也是无法进入这个候选人行列。
只要李皓知道其中的难度，就该明白，唯有加入执法队，才有机会涉足超能。
夜色迷人。
小路上，李皓依旧警惕，默默走着。
张家距离自己家不远。
他这一路上，思考了许多东西，最终决定，还是给老师打个招呼。
“嘟嘟嘟……”
通讯依旧很快被接通，袁硕应该一直在等待，没有睡觉。
“老师！”
“解决了？”
“嗯，刘隆刘队长带人来了，我已经往回走了。”
李皓一边说着，一边考虑着什么，片刻后开口道：“老师，刘队长说，我可能有危险，杀小远的人，可能也想杀我。”
“没事！”
袁硕好像早有猜测，也不在意，随意道：“明天起，你搬进古院，不要去宿舍，直接来我这，不要再出去！避个一两年，问题不大。”

袁硕说的轻松，李皓却是听懂了，袁硕是在拿自己赌，赌巡夜人不会不管他的安危。
李皓躲过去，红影一方除非很强大，否则也不会轻易招惹巡夜人。
可李皓知道，红影恐怕不会轻易罢休的。
何况，让自己一直躲着，李皓也不愿意。
“老师，我还是想留在巡检司。”
“顽固不化！”
袁硕有些恼火，“你既然知道危险，还要留下，你这是愚蠢！而非勇敢！”
“老师，我想……加入执法队！刘队长邀请我加入执法队，说能保护我的安全。”
“执法队？”
“对，而且……他告诉我，也许加入，能通往另外一个领域。”
“呵呵！”
一声不屑的笑声，从通讯中传出。
“刘隆这家伙，还是不死心！哪有那么简单？若是那么简单，人人都是超能者了！他所做的一切，我都知道，刘隆的确是个有毅力，有魄力的家伙。”
袁硕给予了肯定，但是很快说道：“但是，有些事你不懂。他对你说的，一定很简单！可实际情况是，第一，杀那些人，九死一生！第二，引能入体，巡夜人那边是90%的安全率，哪怕不成功，也不会死，可刘隆的方法，对半，引能入体过程中，一半的几率会死！”
李皓眼神微动，这一点，刘隆之前还真没有提。
袁硕又道：“还有，你以为执法队那边，之前就那么几位胆子大的？呵呵，刘隆原本召集了好几十号人，现在身边还有多少人？有些在击杀过程中就死了，有些在引能入体过程中死的！”
袁硕叹息一声：“你若是真想走这条路，也许……我可以帮你申请一次试试……”
他好像有些迟疑，很快又坚定了起来。
而李皓，隐约感受到了老师的为难，这事恐怕不简单。
想到刘隆说的，巡夜人不许老师这边成功，李皓心中有了盘算，轻声道：“老师，不用了！”

“也好！”
袁硕这次没有坚持，听李皓这么说，他就没再提，因为袁硕知道，李皓真去了，也许会出现在巡夜人那10%的死亡率中！
他袁硕尝试，是90%的非死亡人员，但是不会成功。
而李硕，只是他的学生，大概率会出事。
想到这，他也不愿多说什么。
而李皓，听了一番，知道老师也了解刘隆他们的举动，稍微安心了一些，很快道：“老师，那我决定加入执法队，我未必会尝试那种方法，但是我想报仇！”
“你这脾气……”
袁硕摇头不已，很快道：“算了，随你！你性格像我，既然坚持了，那就没有放弃的道理，不过有时间来我这一趟，我无法给予你更多的帮助，但是我可以为你稍微讲解一下其中的道道，这条路，不好走！”
说到这，袁硕忽然笑了：“你要是真能成功了，也许……也是好事！走另外的路成功，那以后，也许你我可以携手做点事，不需要被人辖制，有些家伙，巴不得我一直失败，呵呵，迟早丢开他们！”
这话，李皓隐约间听明白了，但是他没细问。
因为老师想说，一定会说的很详细，显然，还是有些顾忌的。
而这一刻，李皓也下定了决心，去执法队！
老师没有劝阻，代表他了解一些情况，刘隆也许有各种算计，短时间内，应该不会对自己不利。
“红影……超能……我来了！”
李皓心中默念，一年了，就让我见识见识你们的神秘和厉害之处！
content_en:
On top of the tower.
Liu Long landed and left, leaving Li Hao alone.
"Bait..."
Li Hao whispered softly, he completely understood what Liu Long meant.
This guy may look reckless, but he is actually a master of meticulous thinking. After speaking, he appears to be extremely frank and honest.
Not only that, there is another point that Liu Long did not say clearly, but actually made it clear between the lines.
He, Liu Long, doesn't know how to burn bridges, and he is also a person who values ​​friendship!
On this point, Liu Long said several times that he was unwilling to investigate and investigate the moles in the law enforcement team. In this sentence, Liu Long was actually expressing his position.
I can't bear to hurt those who betrayed me.
Li Hao, if you are willing to help me, then I will not be ungrateful.
This is the master!
Moisturizing things is silent and not stated openly, but if you think about it a little, you will understand that even the traitor Liu Long is unwilling to deal with him because of his feelings, let alone others.
"Are you really that emotional?"
Li Hao thought in his heart, but he didn't dare to believe it all, nor did he dare to take it all seriously.
These people are so treacherous.
What Liu Long said just now used too many tactics, including bluffing, making false claims, intimidation, and reasoning... In just a few sentences of conversation, I don't know how many brain cells Liu Long expended.
"Kill the superpower, deprive yourself of the mysterious power, match yourself, introduce it once, introduce it twice, introduce it three times... In this way, you can become a new superpower?"
Li Hao suddenly felt a little chilled.
The world of superpowers doesn't seem so peaceful either.
Even ordinary people like Liu Long want to fight and transform superpowers, but what about superpowers among themselves?
Maybe more sinister!
No wonder these superpowers keep a low profile and do not appear in front of others, probably to avoid some unwarranted troubles.
"Liu Long seemed to be telling me a lot, but in fact he just hit the mark and didn't go into details. Maybe he wouldn't tell me too much if I didn't join the law enforcement team."
For example, the specific training methods of superpowers, energy induction methods, strength, and ability types...
Liu Long didn't say any of these things.
"Also, I have mysterious powers in my body. Is it true or fake? Is it just a deliberate statement to make me lose my composure and admit that I did take something from the Zhang family?"
Li Hao suspected that this was very possible.
Liu Long actually didn't know that Li Hao could see mysterious energy, which was probably not an ability that ordinary people had.
That starlight-like energy is most likely mysterious energy.
What Li Hao could see was that he could see that there was no such energy outside his body. Otherwise, neither Hong Ying nor the person behind Hong Ying would have reacted at all.
Liu Long is most likely deceiving himself!
As for Liu Long himself, Li Hao actually saw something. There seemed to be a weak starlight energy outside the guy's body. It was very weak, and it might be mysterious energy.
"Liu Long has killed superpowers and absorbed their mysterious energy, but I'm afraid it's not time for a qualitative change, so there is a residual mysterious energy in his body. In that case, it is really possible for Liu Long to become a superpower."
Yes, he can see it.
Just like the red shadow!
Most people can't see the red shadow, but Li Hao can.
Not only Liu Long, but also the team members around Liu Long, more or less, really have some mysterious abilities in them.
Li Hao generally guessed that the "we" he mentioned were those team members, the charming woman, Wu Chao who was tracking and exploring, and the other two team members.
Including Liu Long, there are 5 people in total, not everyone in the law enforcement team.
It seems that within the law enforcement team, there is actually a small team, namely the Hunter Alliance formed by Liu Long and others, which specializes in hunting down superpowers.
"A powerful weapon? Or other means?"
A superpower must not be weak, otherwise Liu Long would not have to pursue it so much. However, a superpower died in their hands.This small team is actually quite scary.
The right time and the right place are all on the Inspection Department's side.
The use of powerful weapons is also the power of the Inspection Department. Even if someone pursues it later, the law enforcement team can easily prevaricate it. In this way, it is not impossible for a superpower to be killed by these people if they are not careful.
Li Hao even dared to target superpowers with a Whirlpool III with a range of only 50 meters, let alone Liu Long.
Strictly speaking, this person is actually the real person in charge of the Silver City Violence Agency.
As for the director of the inspection department, he sits in the office and will not come to the front line in person. The law enforcement team is the front line, and Liu Long is the boss here.
Li Hao walked off the top of the tower.
Thinking as you walk.
What will be the consequences if I refuse?
Will Liu Long cause trouble for him?
On Hongying's side, will Liu Long tip off the news and even tell them that the Zhang family's sword and the Li family's sword are all on Li Hao?
Or, just kill yourself secretly?
"He looks like a big and honest guy...but he's actually a cruel guy!"
At this time, Li Hao didn't feel that the other party was reckless at all.
Even the inaction of the law enforcement team may be caused by him deliberately letting outsiders relax their vigilance and allowing superpowers to relax their vigilance and think that the Yincheng law enforcement team is just a faggot.
Show weakness to the enemy!
"The mole... Haha, it couldn't have been cultivated by Liu Long himself on purpose, right? Even if it wasn't, it was the result of his letting go. This guy 100% knew who the mole was. He didn't clean it up, he just did it on purpose!"
Li Hao, whose mind was spinning rapidly, seemed to see many things clearly at this moment.
Liu Long of the law enforcement team is definitely the number one figure!
The chaos in the law enforcement team was most likely caused by him on purpose. This guy is so insidious. No wonder he is called Liu Long. He is really bad and leaking pus!
Li Hao was cursing in his heart, but he also began to think about whether it would be beneficial for him to join?
"If you join them, it will help you deal with Hongying, because Liu Long's target is these superpowers!"
"I'm not familiar with the night watchers, and I don't know the situation. I don't even know if they are related to Hongying. If people like Liu Long really want to become superpowers, they must be more dedicated than the night watchmen, but they are weaker."
"However, having the experience of killing superpowers means that they are not without confidence."
At this moment, Li Hao is Hongying's next target.
Things have become such a big deal today. I'm afraid Hongying's side has already begun to prepare to take action against him, right?
"Actually, I'm just a little scared..."
Li Hao walked onto the street and fell into struggling and contemplation.
What are you afraid of?
Just be afraid...Liu Long and Hongying are actually on the same side, that is the real danger!
This is not impossible.
"In that case, I would be really in danger!"
Li Hao had to think about this at this moment. If Liu Long was with Hongying, then almost everything about him would be exposed at this time.
"Phew!"
The mood is a little heavy.
Tonight's move didn't go too smoothly, with some twists and turns. It would be fine if Liu Long could really deal with Hong Ying, but if he couldn't, then he would be even more in danger.
There was a loud noise, and a large car bulldozed the Zhang family's old house.
Along with a burst of smoke, Li Hao looked silently outside the old house, as if he saw Zhang Yuan.
Xiaoyuan, your home is gone.
You are dead, your home is gone, and the last traces of you left in this world are almost disappearing.
Now, I can only avenge you, use the murderer's head to commemorate you, and give you a ride. I seem to be unable to do anything else.
At this moment, the charming female team member from before quietly approached Li Hao.
A faint fragrance came from the tip of my nose.
A woman's laughter also came to my ears: "Xiao Hao, if you want to join us, you can come to me tomorrow! My sister's name is Liu Yan, the deputy captain of the law enforcement team. You are welcome to come to me at any time!"
She didn't say her name, so Li Hao didn't know who she was.Who, when he mentioned his name... Li Hao knew.
In the confidential room for a year, even if he had never met some people, he had heard their names and their gossip.
Liu Yan is also one of the names that often appears in the confidential room.
I heard that she was Liu Long's mistress... Of course, this was gossip coming from the confidential room. Li Hao didn't know if it was true, but looking at today's situation, it might not be groundless.
Several aunts in the confidential room often spoke of this person in a disdainful tone, saying that they got to the position of deputy captain of the law enforcement team just because of their cheeks.
You know, the deputy captain of the law enforcement team is at least a first-level patrol inspection.
On top of inspections, there are also inspection envoys.
Liu Long is actually the inspector. At this stage, Liu Long truly has the right to speak. His status in the inspection department is second only to the director. None of the deputy directors has as much power as Liu Long.
"Okay!"
Li Hao nodded slightly and agreed readily.
He who knows the current affairs is a hero!
At this time, you can't refuse, and you can't refuse.
He must agree!
"Refreshing!"
Liu Yan suddenly smiled like smoke, "You won't regret it!"
By the time she finished speaking, she had left.
The speed was very fast, but it was still silent, which also made Li Hao secretly frightened. These guys looked like ordinary people, but they were actually very powerful.
Outside the body, there is a faint layer of starlight.
It was very faint and might not be visible from a distance, but at close range, Li Hao could see it clearly.
This is exactly the starlight energy that flows out after the jade sword is soaked in water and cannot be digested after drinking water.
"Half-powerful?"
Li Hao made a definition in his mind. I'm afraid these guys have all introduced energy into their bodies, but they didn't succeed and officially became superpowers.
Liu Long did a good job in the law enforcement team and trained several powerful helpers.
"So, the water soaked in the jade sword is mysterious energy!"
"Liu Long and the others expect to kill superpowers and become superpowers, but I...maybe not necessarily! My jade sword can provide me with mysterious energy, and I also got the Zhang family's sword, but I don't know if the Zhang family's sword can produce mysterious energy."
The rumble continued.
Soon, the flames rose.
The Zhang family was burned down.
Li Hao watched silently, not regretting his choice tonight at all.
Tonight, he got a lot of information, information beyond his imagination. Even if he exposed something about himself, it didn't matter.
I am the sword holder of the Li family, does the Hongying side really not know?
Not necessarily!
They have never done anything to themselves, maybe they have their own ideas.
If their parents were killed by them, how could they not know that their Li is the Li in the Li family's sword!
To think that they don't know is just to deceive yourself.
"With such a loud movement, the other party probably won't show up!"
Li Hao tightened his clothes, kicked the Black Panther beside him, and said softly: "Let's go, go back!"
Without saying goodbye to Liu Long, Li Hao left silently while there was a lot of commotion.
"Boss!"
At this moment, several people gathered around Liu Long. Liu Yan looked at Liu Long with some doubts, then looked at Li Hao who left silently in the darkness, and said softly: "Boss, you really want this person to join us?"
Wu Chao, who was as thin as a bamboo pole, smiled faintly: "The boss naturally has the boss's ideas and reasons! This Li Hao has someone behind him. Although Yuan Shuo is not a superpower, Yuan Shuo possesses the five-animal technique, and his own strength is not weak! Besides, he has been cooperating with the night watchman, so he still has some confidence. It may not be a bad thing to bring Li Hao in."
Another fat man who was so fat that he couldn't see his eyes said dullly: "That can't be said to be a good thing! Yuan Shuo is a proud and arrogant person. It's not like the boss has never looked for the other party before and wanted him to join us and hunt together, but Yuan Shuo dismissed it and invited Li Hao to come, so as to be careful of being targeted by the night watchman..."
Before he finished speaking, Liu Long said coldly: "Night watchman? Do you think the night watchman doesn't know? I, YinchengThe Inspection Department has killed superpowers many times, how could they not know at all? "
After saying that, Liu Long said lightly: "So what if you know? We kill all the superpowers who committed crimes! Moreover, the secret of killing superpowers, stripping away mystical powers, and making mortals transcendent was revealed by the night watchman! Haha..."
With a sneer, Liu Long's eyes were full of disdain and indifference.
"Isn't it that they spread this news just to let us cannon fodder who are determined to become superpowers share the pressure for them? "
"Nowadays, the night watchman seems to have a heavy task and doesn't have time to take care of too much. But once a superpower commits a crime, if he doesn't care about it, it will be a big trouble! However, the night watchman does not have enough power to control it, and it is too dangerous for ordinary people to deal with superpowers. Most people just muddle along. Who wants to really offend a superpower? "
"However, at this time, news came out that killing superpowers, introducing energy into the body, entering the body multiple times, always almost succeeded... What do you think this will lead to? "
As soon as these words came out, everyone fell silent.
What is the result?
Anyone who is unwilling to be ordinary will give it a try!
A life and death fight!
If you have means, weapons, and brains, you may not be unable to defeat a superpower.
They are the best proof!
And does such a thing happen only here in Yincheng?
I'm afraid not!
The night watchman organization spread such news because they wanted to use the hands of people like them who were unwilling to be ordinary to serve as cannon fodder and temporarily solve some of the troubles for the night watchmen.
Liu Long added: "The night watchman's plan is very shrewd! If we people really want to become superpowers, where will we go? "
Liu Yan smiled: "Night watchman! "
Everyone nodded.
If people from the Inspection Department don’t watch the night, will they become heretics?
The big fat man breathed in and said: "What a good calculation. This doesn't mean that they don't spend a little bit of mystical energy. In the end, they may absorb some of the extraordinary people who stand out, and they can also solve some of the superpowers who make trouble! "
Kill two birds with one stone!
The night watchman just revealed a piece of news, and the final result was that he became a member of the Superintendent's Inspection Department and had no choice but to join the night watchman, because the night watchman is official and orthodox!
Few people will become thieves if they are used to being officials.
"It's just a conspiracy! "
Liu Long said calmly: "I don't know about the others, but the group of people who fail every year, these people will not settle for being ordinary! We have also stepped into the transcendent, but we have been kicked back. No one will be willing to accept it! And our group of people are the core strength of each inspection department. We have the soldiers, the power, and the confidence to fight for first-line opportunities! "
"The night watchman doesn't need to pay any price. On the one hand, it allows us to fight, and on the other hand, we can select some seedlings. Why not! "
At this moment, several team members completely understood.
Liu Long hadn't said it in such detail before. Some of the team members understood. Some, like the fat man, were actually worried about being discovered by the night watchman and found out that they were secretly depriving them of mystical powers.
But at this moment, after hearing what the captain said, it suddenly dawned on me!
The big fat man asked again: "Boss, will it be beneficial to us if Li Hao joins? "
"have! "
Liu Long said something, but did not explain why.
Everyone was deep in thought and did not ask any further questions.
As for whether Li Hao will join...you still have to ask?
Definitely!
Several people felt that as long as they knew about the superpower field, no one would refuse Liu Long's invitation.
There is a formal selection process for night watchmen, not to mention the success rate of selecting one out of a hundred after the selection. The key is that Li Hao may not have entered the ranks of candidates in Yincheng.
In the huge Yincheng, there are many people with super powers.
They are all high-level people!
How many high-level officials hope that they or their descendants can become superpowers. For people like Li Hao, the chance is too small. Even if his teacher comes forward, there is a high probability that he will not be able to enter the ranks of candidates.
As long as Li Hao knows the difficulty,You should understand that only by joining the law enforcement team can you have a chance to get involved in superpowers.
The night is charming.
On the path, Li Hao was still alert and walked silently.
The Zhang family is not far from my home.
He thought about a lot of things along the way, and finally decided to say hello to the teacher.
"Dududu..."
The communication was still quickly connected. Yuan Shuo must have been waiting and did not sleep.
"Teacher!"
"Solved?"
"Well, Captain Liu Long and Liu are here, and I've already gone back."
Li Hao was thinking about something as he spoke, and after a moment he said, "Teacher, Captain Liu said that I may be in danger, and the person who killed Xiaoyuan may also want to kill me."
"It's okay!"
Yuan Shuo seemed to have already made a guess and didn't care. He said casually: "Starting from tomorrow, you move into the ancient courtyard. Don't go to the dormitory. Come directly to my place and don't go out again! If you stay away for a year or two, it won't be a big problem."
Yuan Shuo said it easily, but Li Hao understood. Yuan Shuo was betting on himself, betting that the night watchman would not care about his safety.
Li Hao hid. Unless Hongying's side was very powerful, they would not easily provoke the night watchman.
But Li Hao knew that Hongying might not give up easily.
What's more, Li Hao was not willing to let himself hide all the time.
"Teacher, I still want to stay in the Inspection Department."
"Stubborn!"
Yuan Shuo was a little annoyed, "Since you know the danger, you still want to stay. You are stupid! Not brave!"
"Teacher, I want to... join the law enforcement team! Captain Liu invited me to join the law enforcement team, saying that he can protect my safety."
"Law enforcement team?"
"Yes, and...he told me that maybe joining can lead to another field."
"Haha!"
A disdainful laugh came from the communication.
"This guy Liu Long still doesn't give up! How can it be that simple? If it were that simple, everyone would be a superpower! From everything he has done, I know that Liu Long is indeed a perseverant and courageous guy."
Yuan Shuo affirmed, but quickly said: "But, there are some things you don't understand. What he told you must be very simple! But the actual situation is, first, kill those people, and you will escape death! Second, introduce energy into the body. The night watchman's side has a 90% safety rate. Even if it fails, you will not die, but Liu Long's method is half and half. During the process of introducing energy into the body, there is a half chance of death!"
Li Hao's eyes moved slightly. Liu Long really didn't mention this before.
Yuan Shuo added: "Also, do you think there were only a few brave people in the law enforcement team before? Haha, Liu Long originally summoned dozens of people, how many people are there now? Some died during the killing process, and some died while introducing energy into the body!"
Yuan Shuo sighed: "If you really want to take this path, maybe... I can help you apply for a try..."
He seemed to hesitate, but then became determined again.
As for Li Hao, he vaguely felt the teacher's embarrassment. I'm afraid this matter is not simple.
Thinking of what Liu Long said, the night watchman would not allow the teacher to succeed, Li Hao made a plan in his mind and said softly: "Teacher, no need!"
"That's fine!"
Yuan Shuo didn't insist this time. Hearing what Li Hao said, he didn't mention it again, because Yuan Shuo knew that if Li Hao really went, he might appear in the 10% mortality rate of the night watchman!
He Yuan Shuo tried, 90% of the non-dead people, but he would not succeed.
And Li Shuo is just his student, so there is a high probability that something will happen.
Thinking of this, he didn't want to say anything more.
Li Hao, after listening to it, knew that the teacher also understood Liu Long's actions, and felt a little relieved. He quickly said: "Teacher, then I decided to join the law enforcement team. I may not try that method, but I want revenge!"
"Your temper..."
Yuan Shuo shook his head and said quickly: "Forget it, it's up to you! Your personality is like mine. Since you persist, there is no reason to give up. But if you have time to come to me, I can'tI will give you more help, but I can explain a little bit about it. This road is not easy to walk! "
Speaking of this, Yuan Shuo suddenly smiled: "If you can really succeed, maybe... it will be a good thing! If you succeed in taking another path, then maybe you and I can do something together without being controlled by others. Some guys wish that I keep failing, haha, sooner or later, let them go! "
Li Hao vaguely understood this, but he didn't ask in detail.
Because if the teacher wants to say something, he will definitely explain it in detail. Obviously, he still has some scruples.
At this moment, Li Hao also made up his mind to go to the law enforcement team!
The teacher did not dissuade him, which meant that he understood some of the situation. Liu Long may have various calculations, which should not be detrimental to him in a short period of time.
"Hongying... super power... here I come! "
Li Hao thought silently in his heart, one year has passed, let me see your mystery and power!
